name: website-uptime-monitor
description: Check a list of websites, remember which ones were down last time, and only alert when something goes down or comes back up.

urls.description: Comma-separated list of URLs to check

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for each site before calling it down

state_key.description: Name of the saved snapshot. Use a different key per monitor.

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for alerts (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const url = process.env.URL; const started = Date.now(); fetch(url, { redirect: "follow", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(Number(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_TIMEOUT_MS)) }).then(r => ({ url, up: r.status < 400, status: r.status }), e => ({ url, up: false, status: 0, error: String((e.cause && e.cause.code) || e.name) })).then(result => { result.ms = Date.now() - started; console.log(JSON.stringify(result)) })'

node -e 'const rows = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).map(r => r.probe); const down = rows.filter(r => !r.up); console.log(JSON.stringify({ checked: rows.length, up: rows.length - down.length, down: down.map(r => r.url).sort(), details: rows }))'
node -e 'const s = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({ down: s.down }))'

node -e 'const s = JSON.parse(process.env.SUMMARY); const raw = JSON.parse(process.env.DIFF); const d = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw; const before = (d.before && d.before.down) || []; const after = (d.after && d.after.down) || []; const newlyDown = after.filter(u => !before.includes(u)); const recovered = before.filter(u => !after.includes(u)); const why = u => { const r = s.details.find(x => x.url === u); return r.status ? "HTTP " + r.status : r.error }; const lines = []; newlyDown.forEach(u => lines.push("🔴 DOWN: " + u + " (" + why(u) + ")")); recovered.forEach(u => lines.push("✅ RECOVERED: " + u)); const alert = lines.length > 0; lines.push("Checked " + s.checked + " sites: " + s.up + " up, " + s.down.length + " down."); console.log(JSON.stringify({ alert, message: lines.join("\n"), newlyDown, recovered, details: s.details }))'
if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
